notes: No personal site/CV. Built from the scholar's self-registered RePEc/IDEAS page (journal articles, chapters, and working papers not later published), plus World Bank PRWP versions listed there. Working papers whose journal version exists were dropped; pre-2015 RFF/NBER discussion papers and HAL/FEEM duplicates, conference papers and policy commentaries (C.D. Howe, ifo DICE Report) skipped. Rate-Based Emissions Trading (NBER 33197/PRWP 10872): IDEAS gives surnames only for Qu and Goulder (first names not shown). Cleary et al. handbook chapter: first name of Cleary not shown on IDEAS (Fischer is 2nd of 3). 'Policy Design for the Anthropocene' (Nature Sustainability 2019) omitted because IDEAS truncates the author list. Journal article order/years follow IDEAS (e.g. Fischer-Fox AER P&P 2011; Anderson-Parry-Sallee-Fischer RREP 2011). PRWP year taken as latest version (2022-2024). IDEAS likely lacks post-2024 items.
